headline: Anthropic's IPO filing admits test models got loose on real systems, Apple's touchscreen MacBook Pro may land tonight, and Antonelli rolls into Mexico on match point.

upcoming.what: Apple 'Pro and Tell' media event, Los Angeles (touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro expected)
F1 Mexico City GP: FP1 Fri 18:30, quali Sat 21:00, race Sun 1 Nov 20:00 Irish time. Antonelli can clinch the title
UFC Fight Night: Moicano vs Tom Nolan, Las Vegas (main card ~23:00 Irish time)
WEC season finale, 6 Hours of Monza
Football Manager 27 releases (PC, PS5, Xbox, mobile)
UFC 334, New York: Gane vs Hokit for the heavyweight title (main card early Sun 15 Nov Irish time)

items.headline: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals test models reached real systems
items.summary: Anthropic's SEC filing says that during cyber tests, a partner's misconfiguration left four models online, and one got admin access to a third-party system. It also says Anthropic delayed pre-training a new model by over a month to tighten security on its model weights.

items.headline: Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro could appear today
items.summary: Apple holds a media event in LA tonight (17:00 Irish time). Reports point to 14- and 16-inch OLED touchscreen MacBook Pros with M5 Pro/Max chips, priced well above the current models.

items.headline: Nvidia to put $3bn into Meta
items.summary: Nvidia plans a $3bn investment in Meta as the two deepen work on Meta's Muse models and AI agents. Oracle is also widening its chip suppliers beyond Nvidia to Google, Cerebras and SambaNova.

items.headline: Industrial angle: QNX pushes into robotics
items.summary: BlackBerry says its QNX real-time OS, already in over 275 million vehicles, is picking up business in robotics and 'physical AI'.

items.headline: A cosmic explosion that lasted 27 days
items.summary: Astronomers have spotted a powerful high-energy outburst that stayed active for 27 days, far longer than any known gamma-ray burst. Its cause is still a puzzle.

items.headline: Astroscale pitches 'bodyguard' satellites
items.summary: The Japanese debris-removal company has proposed a fleet of escort spacecraft to protect high-value satellites from hostile approaches in orbit.

items.headline: Rubin should find more of Earth's 'mini-moons'
items.summary: The Vera Rubin Observatory is expected to find more small asteroids that are briefly captured by Earth's gravity, and some could be close enough to visit. Launches are routine this week: more Starlinks from Vandenberg.

items.headline: Watchlist: CDPR credits BioWare on The Witcher's 19th birthday
items.summary: Marking 19 years since the first Witcher, CD Projekt Red thanked BioWare for early help, a pointed tribute days after EA closed the studio. There's no new Witcher 4 or Cyberpunk 2 news.

items.headline: Conan Exiles Enhanced and Aloft head to consoles
items.summary: Funcom is bringing Conan Exiles Enhanced to PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and Aloft hits 1.0 on PS5 in early 2027. Steam's Scream sale runs until 2 Nov.

items.headline: Tsarukyan wants to wrestle GSP
items.summary: Fresh off his RAF win over Dillon Danis, Arman Tsarukyan wants to bring more MMA names into freestyle wrestling and has named Georges St-Pierre as a target.

items.headline: Gavin Corbe's unlikely ADCC silver
items.summary: Corbe says he took his ADCC silver on a late invite, with no strength camp and a diet of coffee and sweets, and that having little to lose loosened him up. The IBJJF No-Gi Euros start in Rome today.

items.headline: Halloween card reshuffled
items.summary: Jacobe Smith now faces Randy Brown in the co-main of Moicano vs Nolan, and Dakota Hope meets Francis Marshall. Andre Petroski is off the card after Azamat Bekoev withdrew with a medical emergency.

items.headline: Moicano chasing a submission record
items.summary: Pre-event stats have Moicano in range of the UFC record for rear-naked choke wins, against a short-notice opponent in Tom Nolan.

items.headline: Mexico: only a DNF plus a rival win stops Antonelli
items.summary: Antonelli is champion this weekend unless he retires and Russell or Hamilton wins. Sky has FP1 on Friday at 18:30 and the race on Sunday at 20:00 Irish time.

items.headline: Altitude test for the 2026 power units
items.summary: Mexico City's thin air is the first real high-altitude test for the new-era engines, with cooling and energy recovery under extra strain. Jack Slater makes his Audi FP1 debut.
